claim: PepsiCo reported $64.1 billion of revenue for Q3 2024.
summary: PepsiCo's reported revenue for Q3 2024 alone was approximately $23.3 billion, not $64.1 billion. $64.1 billion corresponds to the cumulative year-to-date (first 36 weeks) revenue through Q3 2024 (~$64.07B), misattributed as a single-quarter figure.

sub_claims.text: PepsiCo reported revenue of $64.1 billion for Q3 2024
sub_claims.stated_text: reported $64.1 billion of revenue for Q3 2024
sub_claims.note: Q3 2024 standalone net revenue was ~$23.32 billion; $64.1 billion approximates the 36-week year-to-date total (Q1+Q2+Q3 2024 ~ $64.07 billion) reported on Oct 8, 2024, not the quarterly amount.
